For reference, we do use graphemes to determine movement:

https://github.com/helix-editor/helix/blob/82fc28a0ce2cb2b86968335f32e95aaff3e2cba4/helix-term/src/commands.rs#L2570

The way you've reproduced it should have triggered the bug, I can reproduce it every time on my two Win10 systems. Another interesting thing is that this only happens when the line was changed without leaving `INS` mode.
i.e. if I do the same steps but go to `NOR` mode after step 1. and back to `INS` it doesn't panic.

---

Another panic I can consistently trigger is using <kbd>Del</kbd> at the end of a line, though this one might be unrelated to the above:

Both panics are fixed for me, thanks.
